resources.string: Attach up to 4 documents per message.
Choose a PDF or a UTF-8 text, code, Markdown, JSON or CSV file. Binary files are not supported.
This file exceeds the 5 MiB limit. Choose a smaller file.
The extracted text exceeds 200,000 characters. Split the document and try again.
This PDF exceeds 100 pages. Split it and try again.
Encrypted PDFs are not supported. Export an unencrypted copy first.
No readable text was found. Empty files and scanned PDFs without a text layer are not supported.
Could not read this file. It may be damaged, unavailable or too complex. Choose a simpler copy and try again.
